title: New in Symfony 8.2: Polymorphic Form Collections
content:
<html><head></head><body>The CollectionType field is the standard way of editing a list of items in a
Symfony form, but it has two limitations: all its entries must use the same form
type, and submitted rows are matched to entries by their position in the
collection. Symfony 8.2…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
